title: Round Wood Plaque with Photo Engraving
description: Natural wood plaque with custom photo engraving and Hebrew text, a perfect gift for special occasions and preserving memories
longDescription: Elegantly designed and personalized memorial plaque crafted from premium natural wood with precise laser engraving. The product allows commemoration of personal, couple, or family photos along with custom Hebrew text. The plaque comes with an elegant wooden stand that provides stable placement on various surfaces. Each piece is fully customized and created with professional handcraftsmanship with attention to the smallest details.
